card.band: 8h. A frontier agent covers the core options in some trials but misses the parallel branches: context-line merging, binary detection, multibyte locales, backreferences, error text. A weaker model stops at basic matching and -n/-c. Buckets: matcher, output options, recursion, encoding, diagnostics.
card.cheat: Calling system grep or busybox: the image has neither on PATH at test time, and the verifier runs in a sandbox with them removed. Special-casing visible tests: the hidden cases are generated and differ from the visible ones.
card.grading: Hidden cases are generated (pattern, flags, input file sets, locale) and the real GNU grep binary, kept outside the image, supplies stdout, stderr and exit status. Exact match. Add the upstream tests/*.tests table files (spencer1/2 and others) as a second bucket; score is the fraction of cases passed, bucketed by option family.
card.reference: Upstream GNU grep itself defines what is correct. The reference solution is a clean-room implementation we would write, about 4-6k lines; its size is not yet measured. It is expected to pass nearly all cases except exotic PCRE and obscure locales, which are left out of scope.
card.task: /app ships an empty Rust or C project, a grep-compatible CLI spec (man page text) and the visible subset of the shell tests. The agent builds grep: -E/-F/-G/-P-lite, -o -c -l -L -n -b -H -Z, -A/-B/-C, -r/-R with include/exclude, --color, -z, -f, -m, binary-file handling, exit codes and messages, UTF-8 and C locales. It uses its own matcher (no system grep call).

v1.kill_reason: As scoped (full grep: -P-lite, backrefs, multibyte locales, binary detection, recursion, color, exact stderr text, against an unwritten 4-6k-line reference), no evidenced trial is likely to reach 0.9 of the reference within the 8h tier. Re-scope to a smaller real subset (BRE/ERE/-F matcher, -n -c -l -o -H, -A/-B/-C, -r with include/exclude, C locale, exit codes) and re-validate; build cost is also borderline against the 5-day limit.

Band.why: Seed claims frontier gets core options only; no dated public evidence, so capped at 3

Build.why: Reference of 4-6k lines with exact GNU behaviour is likely 3-5+ days of work

Fit.why: CPU-only and small; needs locale packages in the image

Hor.why: Breadth across matcher, output, recursion, encodings and diagnostics suits an 8h tier

Lic.why: GPL-3.0-or-later allows shipping tests and oracle; licence text itself not verified this session

Multi.why: Five natural buckets (matcher, output, recursion, encoding, diagnostics) with steady partial credit

Nov.why: Grep-clone subject overlaps regex-engine crowded theme and an existing public Rust port (uutils/grep)

Real.why: Real upstream GNU project with long history and public test tables; pinned commit not verified this session

Ref.why: No reference exists; a clean-room 4-6k-line reference is planned and unmeasured

Seal.why: Oracle and reference kept out of image, but GNU grep and its spencer tests are public and largely recallable

Surf.why: Generated cases diffed against a real binary give an executable oracle with an unlimited generator

spike_plan.kill_if: Spencer tables absent or nondeterministic across runs, locales unavailable, or the minimal matcher cannot reach a meaningful share of core cases, which would show the full scope is too large for an 8h run.
spike_plan.pass_if: Release builds offline-clean, spencer tables give hundreds of deterministic cases, locales present, three generator runs identical, and the minimal matcher passes at least half of the core cases in 30 minutes.
steps: In a throwaway networked Debian container, fetch the GNU grep 3.12 release tarball from ftp.gnu.org and verify its signature; check COPYING reads GPLv3 or later.
Run ./configure && make && make check; record per-file counts for tests/spencer1.tests and tests/spencer2.tests and any other *.tests files.

Generate about 300 random (pattern, flags, file, locale) cases over the core families (BRE/ERE/-F, -o -c -l -n -H -A/-B/-C, -r, exit codes) and record GNU grep stdout, stderr and status; run the generator three times and confirm byte-identical output.
Check that en_US.UTF-8 and C.UTF-8 locales exist in the image so the locale bucket is reproducible.

Time-box 30 minutes to write a minimal BRE/ERE/-F matcher with -n -c -l -o and score it against the generated core cases to estimate how much of the scope a first hour of work covers and how many lines it takes.

v1.summary: The GNU grep seed is real and its grading surface is large and executable: generated cases diffed against the real binary, plus upstream spencer tables from older releases. It fails as scoped because no reference exists, the full scope is unlikely to reach 0.9 of reference in 8h, and building the 4-6k-line reference is borderline on cost; a re-scoped subset is worth a spike.
